layout_and_spacing.global: Generous spacing. Use p-4 to p-8 for dashboard cards. For POS interface, prioritize large touch targets.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B (Control Room): grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Left sidebar (280px fixed width) + Main Content area.
layout_and_spacing.pos_grid: Split View Layout: Left 70% Product Bento Grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4), Right 30% Cart/Checkout Panel (w-full lg:w-[400px] border-l bg-white).
layout_and_spacing.radius: rounded-xl for main cards/modals, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for status badges. Soft corners for approachable clinical feel.

components.buttons: Shadcn defaults customized with rounded-lg. Add 'h-14 text-lg' for POS fast-action buttons (touch optimization).
components.cards: Solid white bg (bg-white) with a crisp 1px border (border-slate-200) and minimal shadow (shadow-sm). Hover state: shadow-md.
components.tables: Shadcn tables. Compact padding (p-2) for dense data (Stock, Suppliers), generous padding (p-4) for user-facing lists. Zebra striping optional.
components.pos_item_card: Vertical stack layout: Product Image (h-28 object-cover rounded-t-lg), Content area with Title (truncate 1 line), Price (bold emerald text), and absolute positioned Stock Badge (top-right).

motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons, inputs, and hovers.
motion.modals: Framer motion scale-up (0.95 to 1) and opacity fade-in for payment and checkout modals.
motion.toast: Slide in from bottom-right using Sonner toast.

icons_and_assets.style: Stroke width 1.5 for a crisp, technical look. Sizing: w-5 h-5 standard inline, w-10 h-10 for empty state illustrations.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio. White text on primary Emerald background. Dark text on light Warning backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all clickable elements in the POS interface (cashier screen).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-add-to-cart', data-testid='sidebar-nav-stock').

image_urls.description: Premium clinical parapharmacy interior background with soft green light blur
Pharmacy historical vintage layout for about or generic blocks

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Dashboard layout using the F-Pattern: Top left for North Star Metric (Total CA/Sales), Top row for KPIs, left sidebar for navigation.
Use Manrope for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for tabular data, barcodes, and body text. Run `yarn add @fontsource/manrope @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans` if needed.
POS Screen must be highly optimized for touch and speed. Use a split layout: Grid of product cards on the left, sticky cart on the right. POS buttons must be large (h-14).
Use Forest Green (#10B981) as the primary brand color for CTAs to instill health and confirmation, completely avoiding the forbidden clinical 'Teal (#1B93A4)'.
Implement Stock Alerts using the Warning (#F59E0B) and Danger (#EF4444) colors strictly. Use badges to highlight low stock and expiry risks prominently.
CRITICAL: Always use the exact image URLs provided in the `image_urls` block for placeholders, logins, and avatars. Do NOT use dummyimage.com or generic placeholders.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, table rows) has a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-pos', data-testid='product-card-1').
Customize Shadcn components by setting rounded-lg and rounded-xl to soften the interface slightly, matching the 'Organic & Earthy' Archetype 1 guidelines.
Ensure the invoice PDF generation leverages a clean, high-contrast monochrome layout for clear printing.
